_comment: Singletons that intentionally do NOT wire into the GameLifecycle reset path. Every entry must carry a reason; check-reset-coverage.mjs rejects an empty one. Entries marked NEEDS REVIEW hold run-adjacent state whose exemption has not been verified with an owner — they are recorded rather than silently assumed safe.

exemptFiles.reason: Boot-time registry, frozen after startup; no per-run mutation.
NEEDS REVIEW: module-level enemyIdCounter is only zeroed in the constructor, so enemy ids climb across runs. Benign today, unverified as intentional.
Stateless API wrapper; no instance fields.
Admin-only; the isRunning flag tracks the panel lifecycle, not a run.
Admin-only load-once flags; never read during a run.
Diagnostics buffers are session-scoped by design. gameContext looks run-scoped but setGameContext has no callers anywhere, so it stays permanently empty.
start() clears frameTimes/fpsHistory/frameCount, so every measurement window begins clean.
Account-scoped player identity plus a heartbeat timer; deliberately outlives a run.
Account-scoped profile cache; outliving a run is the point.
Stateless API wrapper; no instance fields.
Stateless API wrapper; auth state lives in RailwayAuthTokenStore.
Account-scoped session, not run-scoped.
Stateless; no instance fields beyond the singleton handle.
NEEDS REVIEW: module-level __debugFireCount is only zeroed in the constructor. DEV-only counter, unverified as intentional.
Holds only its movement/collision/collection dependencies; those reset themselves.
NEEDS REVIEW: nearby* scratch references to live entities are nulled on the normal path, but a throw between set and clear would pin a dead run.
NEEDS REVIEW: circuit-breaker counters and open/half-open state survive a run. Arguably correct while the underlying service is still down — needs an owner decision.
Session-scoped via startSession/endSession; the event buffer clears on a clean endSession.
Only an isResetting re-entrancy flag, set and cleared within one reset.
Session-scoped via startSession/endSession, driven from GameStateManager.
Already wired: it listens for gameReset and beforeReset and calls reset(). The exemption is redundant and kept only so the guard does not double-count it.
Reset transitively by DifficultyContext.reset(); asserted in DifficultyContextReset.test.ts.
Reset transitively by DifficultyContext.reset(); asserted in DifficultyContextReset.test.ts.
Reset transitively by DifficultyContext.reset(); asserted in DifficultyContextReset.test.ts.
Stateless API wrapper; no instance fields.
Stateless API wrapper; balances live server-side.
Cache with explicit invalidate(); staleness is a cache concern, not run state.
NEEDS REVIEW: holds real per-run state and does have reset(), but it is called from a GameEngine effect rather than the canonical path, so it depends on that component staying mounted.
Holds only sub-renderer dependencies.
Holds only static viewport bounds.

NEEDS REVIEW: warning counts, escalations and the speed-hack baseline accumulate for the whole session with no reset(). Session accumulation may be deliberate (resetting per run would let a player dodge escalation by restarting) but the timing samples probably should not span runs. Needs a security decision.
Load-once flag; assets are app-scoped.
Debug log buffer, deliberately process-lifetime.
Capability flag only.
Load-once promise; images are app-scoped.
Recording buffer with explicit start()/clear(); no production caller starts it.
Bounded ring buffer, deliberately process-lifetime.
NEEDS REVIEW: public mutable tuning read on the hot path, with reset() reachable only from the debug panel. Resetting per run may be undesirable while a developer iterates.
Single lastHealthCheck timestamp; infrastructure-scoped.
100ms TTL cache.
Cross-run by design: a retry queue persisted to localStorage so a pending verification survives a reload.
